limitations: The designated mainnet API key and secret variables were absent, so no signed USER_DATA request was sent.

No exact current collateral asset eligibility Simple Earn tier APR loan interest rate initial margin-call or liquidation LTV quantity duration reward history income row or repayment conversion cost was accessed.
Keeping collateral rewards does not prove the loan is cheaper than no borrowing sale of collateral or an external loan alternative.

Overcollateralization liquidation and collateral or borrowed-asset price movement make the total position market-sensitive even though the collateral reward overlay itself needs no price-direction forecast.
Borrowed assets cannot be treated as free capital and collateral rewards cannot be double-counted with any already accepted idle-balance yield.
prohibited_actions: borrowing merely to capture Simple Earn collateral rewards
subscribing acquiring or retaining a collateral asset merely to make it loan-eligible
crediting a logged-out Max or headline APR instead of the exact owned collateral reward
ignoring variable loan interest LTV liquidation fee collateral price basis and opportunity costs
double-counting the same Simple Earn reward as both idle-balance yield and loan-collateral yield
using leverage loan proceeds or reinvestment as the edge
calling the collateral reward a profitable loan before the full exact-unit break-even contract passes
sending a signed request without both ephemeral credentials and read-only authority or calling any TRADE endpoint without separate funded authority
